tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sde brgyad kyi sgos mdos kyi gyer mchod bzhugs so//

༄༅// dpal ye shes mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// lha'i gyer/ kyai stong gsum mi mjed zhing khams 'dir// bskal bzang sgron ma thams cad dang*// smon lam gcig tu btab pa'i mthus// srid pa'i bdag por sku 'khrungs nas// sems can smin par mdzad pa'i phyir// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing*// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// sa dang lam la gnas byas nas// 'jig rten dbang po'i tshul bstan pa'i// gtso bo dam pa mchog rab ni// ri rab chen po'i zom rtse na// dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang*// btsun mo u ma de wī gnyis// mi ro rta ro'i gdan la bzhugs// phyag na srid pa'i mes po dang*// 'gugs byed rlung gi zhags pa bsnams// khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan brjod pa// mu stegs gu lang nag po ste// lam gol zhugs pa ston par 'dzin// khyod kyi sngon gyi rabs shes pa// tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i dbu steng ma// de yis bshad par brtsams pa'i mod// khyod kyis sen mo btab pas chad// de nas de yang gdong bzhir grags// de yi sdig pa sbyang bzhed nas// dka' thub spyad pa khyod kyi ming*// lha chen dka' thub pa zhes 'bod// de la dga' rab dbang phyug khros// chags pa'i mda' chen khyod la 'phangs// lha mo u ma de wīr 'khrigs// spyad pas ma ngoms lus phyed ni// bud med rnams kyis dbang phyug sbyar// de lan khros pa'i mig gsum nas// zhugs spros bdud kyi lus po bsregs// de yang lus med ming du song*// khyod mtshan drag po mig gsum pa// gzhan gyis thub pa su yang med// de yi nga rgyal rgyal rnams kyis// gsang ba'i bdag pos khyod btul bas// thal ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lung bstan mdzad// stong gsum 'di yi bdag po lags// gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga dang*// bsam gtan gnyis pa gsum pa yi// lha tshogs thams cad 'khor du bskor// de 'og tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa// chung ngu'i stong gi bdag po ste// bsam gtan dang po de yi 'khor// dga' byed dbang phyug 'dod pa'i bdag

/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'phrul dga' dang*// dga' ldan 'thab bral lha dang bcas// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nas// lha dbang nye dbang sum cu gnyis// rgyal chen rtag myos 'phreng thogs dang*// gzhong thogs bar snang lha bran sogs// lha yi mgon po chen po ni// rang rigs sde dpung 'khor bcas la// rin chen ngar gyi ri rab ni// zur bzhi logs bzhi bang rim bzhi// zhabs ni mi 'gyur sa la bgrad// rtse la 'dod yon rgyan dang ldan// gzugs dang 'dod khams lha yi nor// bshos bu dza gad gser skyems dang*// khyu mchog ngang pa chu srin rta// glang po rma bya khyung seng ge /stag gzig rnams kyi rgyal mtshan bkod// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sprul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba kun// bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// stongs grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa dgra la sgyur// phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong zlog /chags che lan chags 'dis bskang ngo*// dus la bab nas 'chir thug na'ang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud nas// lo gsum bar du bshol bar mdzod// bdud kyi gyer/ hūm̐ tsa ri dpal gyi ri zlum na// mi lus seng ge'i mgo bo can// bskos rje brang dkar lus nag po// bdud mo seng ge'i gdong mar bcas// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// phyag na ru mtshon dmar gtor 'phyar// zhal nas dug gi ngan skyugs 'thong*// dgra bo'i srog lus khyab par byed// bar snang khams la rgyug byed cing*// sprul pa 'jigs byed dus mtshan te// las mdzad mgar ba nag po dang*// gshin rje klu dang bdud dang btsan// gnod sbyin srog bdag ma mos skor// khyod du ma sprul ma brdzus pa// lus can kun gyi zhe sdang nyid// rtsa khams rang la bdud bzhir gnas// nyams pa'i gshed du ldang ba yin// de yi dbang las khyod kyi gzugs// mi ser rta ser phung po'i bdud// mi sngon rta sngon nyon mongs bdud// mi dkar rta dkar lha yi bdud// mi nag rta nag 'chi bdag bdud// bdud po bye ba 'bum 'bum spro// srid pa bskos la 'debs pa la// khyab pa lag rings khyod kyi rdzu// nying sprul gar gyi dbang phyug dang*// ma bdud brgya byin gshos pa las// las kyi shugs 'gro bcu gnyis dang*// sbas pa'i bu mo thal mdog ma// srid gsum kha sbub gtong ba mo// gnam phyed gos su gyon pa mo// sa phyed gdan du bting ba mo// de dang yab bdud nag po gshos// bdud bu mched sde bcu gsum byung*// gzhan yang khyod kyi 'phrul gyi gzugs// re ti mgo g.yag bdud kyi bu// bshor ba gzhon nu bdud kyi mchog

/zangs sder mche ba bdud kyi gtso// ling phyi sha khrag bdud kyi tsha// ma hā ho mo bdud kyi 'khor// bdud kyi bu ni lnga brgyar bcas// phyi rje khyung lding bdud kyi rje// yab rje bla med bdud kyi 'khor// ra kham gsor mig bdud kyi mchog /'gram po skya bdun bdud kyi 'khor// phag zhon nag po bdud kyi sde// gnya' rings khrag med 'khor dang bcas// yab bdud phyag brnyan bcas pa dang*// pho bdud mo bdud byis pa'i bdud// rang rang sde dpung bcas pa ste// bdud kyi blon po chen po bzhi// rta pa lag g.yas mdung thogs shing*// g.yon pa tshe 'phang mda' bas rno// rta kha srab bzhin rje kha blon// dam can badz+ra sā dhu ni/ sngags pa kun gyi 'bangs gcig pu// 'ol god stong rje de dang ni// bdud gza' smin dkar gnyis kyi sras// mched ni sum brgya drug cu ste// rgya gar rgya nag zhang zhung na// brgya brgya bod na drug cu lags// khyod kyi skyob sangs bzang ra dang*/ khab tu mdza' btsal ya ma skyong*// kha rag khyung btsun srod kyi mdza'// tho rangs dgyes te kong btsun ma// gtan grogs gangs dkar sha med de// de ltar bdud dmag dung phyur bcas// mi bsrun khyed rnams he ru ka /dregs mdzad phyag na rdo rjes btul// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung mar bskos// phyis nas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// rtsis la phab pa rjes dgongs shig /bdud kyi mgon po chen po ni// rang rigs sde dpung 'khor bcas la/ ri rab nag po bang rim gnyis// zhes sdang thod mkhar bdud kyi mkhar// logs bzhi mi dang spre'u dang*// lug dang rta yi thod pas brtsigs// zur bzhi rin chen zangs la byas// rin chen gser gyi ri bzhi la// shel gyi sgo mo dkar mo btsugs// mu men 'phrul gyi yags shing la// dkar po dung gi gtan pa gsal// rmang rdo nag po lcags las byas// kha bad sngonapo g.yu las byas// thod mkhar khra bo de yi nang*// mi ro rta ro gcal du bkra ma// mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil// mi rta'i pags pas yol ba bres// gsur chen dud pa thu lu lu// mi rkang gling bu cong ngo ngo*// mi mgo bgad mo ya la la// de 'dra'i sku mkhar dam pa dang*// la dgu klung dgu'i ljongs rnams dang*// seng ge glang chen rta bya khyi// g.yag 'brug ra phag dom bya rgod// khyung nag za 'og rgyal mtshan dang*// sha khrag snying bshos gser skyems dang*// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sbrul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba kun// bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// stongs grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad sgyur// phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong zlog

/chags che lan chags 'dis bskang ngo*// dus la bab nas 'chir thug na'ang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud nas// lo gsum bar du bshol bar mdzod// gshin rje'i gyer/ hūm̐ ma traṃ ru dra bsgral dus kyi// 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho ni// legs ldan nyi ma'i bu ru 'khrungs// chos kyi rgyal po chen por grags// yum chen nag po tsā muṇ+ḍi// 'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri'i 'og /dbang chen gser gyi gzhi mo'i steng*// de nas lnga brgya 'das pa na// gshin rje'i rgyal khams chen por snang*// yangs pa can gyi thad mnyam na// yi dwags rnams kyi rgyal khams te// sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug ni// thod pa lcags kyi ra bas bskor// de na khyod bzhugs 'jig rten gyi// gson po skos la 'debs pa dang*// shi ba rnams kyi rje bor 'gyur// las kyi gshin rje zhes su grags// lus can kun gyi thod pa na// mngon sum khyod bzhugs gshed langs pas// 'chi bdag gtum po'i kha na tshud// de phyir 'chi bdag srog bdag dang*// tshe bdag nag po gsang ba'i mtshan// chos rgyal ya ba ti dang ni// glang mgo ral pa tshar dgu dang*// phywa sang tel pa rmig pa dang*// mig dmar sde dpon pho mo brgyad// lo gshed zla gshed bcu gnyis te// zhag gshed sum brgya drug cu dang*// za gshed bdun brgya nyi shu sogs// gshin rje pho mo dung 'phyur dang*// yi dwags ma lus thams cad dang*// grul bum stong sde grib gnon te// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// bcu drug zhabs kyis lcags mkhar brdzis// 'khor bcas bcings nas mna' bor bcug /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung mar bzhag /gshin rje'i mgon po chen po khyod// rang rigs sde dpung 'khor bcas la// ri rab nag po bang rim gsum// thod pa'i grong khyer chen po dang*// rta dmar ra dkar lug nag dang*// g.yag kham ma he 'ug pa srin// rma bya dom gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/

ba dan khram shing sha khrag snying*// bshos bu dza gad gser gyi skyems// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sprul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba kun// bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// stongs grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad sgyur// phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong bzlog /chags che lan chags 'dis bskang ngo*// dus la bab nas 'chir thug na'ang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud nas// lo gsum bar du bshol bar mdzod// gza'i gyer/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag mngon sum rgyu ba ni// gza' bdud chen po khyod lags so// khyod ni sngon dus dge slong che// nyes med rgyal pos khrims la sbyar// de dus smon lam btab pa las// gza' bdud chen po khyod du 'khrungs// btsun mo bzhi yang sring mor te// rgyal po 'khor bcas brlag par byas// rgyal ba rin chen snying po'i bkas// sangs rgyas bstan la zhugs par gyur// de nas bskal pa bzang po 'dir// yab ni srin po glog 'phreng can// yum ni sbal mgo khrag mig ma// sras mchog khyod de lus kyi stod// srin po mgo dgu bya rog gdong*// smad ni sbrul mjug chen por 'khyil// sku mdog dud kha mig gis gang*// mgrin dang lte ba'i phyogs dag tu// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i kha re gdangs// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i mchod gnas kyi// drang srong chen po khyod kyi mtshan// lha min dmag dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ rā hu la zhes 'jig rten sgrog /lha yi bdud rtsi brkus pa'i dus// khyab 'jug chen po zhes su btags// 'jig rten bsgral bar rgyu ba'i ming*// ki kaṃ chen po zhes grags so// pha yis skye 'gro zas su byin// ra rog rten du bzhag par byas// mas sman mngar gsum 'o ma byin// khyod kyi gdug pa'i me sbal gyis// skye dgu thams cad zad nye bas// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khros nas// 'khor lo 'phangs pa khyod la phob// sku ni dum bu brgyad du bsnyil// lha srin sde brgyad sde dpon du// lha chen gza' bdud brgyad du gyur// ljang sngon drag po rā hu la// rog ti nag po biṣ+ṭi dang*// biṣ+ṇu mjug rings bi nā ya// drang srong dkar ser zhes su grags// de nas phyag na rdo rje yis// dbang bskur dam la btags nas su// gsang sngags rgyud kyi bka' gnyer bskos// lhag par ston pa shāka thub kyis// bstan pa rin chen sgrom bu bcol// he ru ka yi sprul par grags// e ka dza ṭī'i pho nya ba// gza' yi rgyal po pa ba sangs// gza' yi blon po mig dmar yin// gza' yi thugs rje nyi ma ste// gza' yi phyag mtshan spen pa dang*// gza' yi 'od gsal zla ba dang*// gza' yi rkos pa lag pa lags// phyag brnyan sgra gcan 'dzin chen po// gza' bdud nyi bdud zla bdud dang*// skar bdud la sogs gza' kun dang*// gling bzhi'i mkha' la rgyu ba yi// smin drug la sogs rgyu skar ni// 'char ba dang yang nub pas ni// 'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu// 'jig rten du ni zad 'phel dang*// dus dang lo tshigs mtshams sbyor byed// lho nub rnga yab gling phran nas/

laṅka'i ri bo mā la yar// gnas pa laṅka mgrin bcu dang*// nag po glog 'phreng la sogs pa'i// srin po bye ba dung 'phyur dang*// srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig sogs// gzugs phung che la hal bag can// thag bzang ris dang stobs ldan sogs// khro gtum lha min tshogs bcas pa'i// gza' bdud chen po lha min mgon// rang rigs sde dpung 'khor bcas pa// rin chen ngar gyi ri rab ni// nag po bang rim gsum pa'i steng*// rin chen gter gyi bum pa la// mi bya rta g.yag ra lug rtol// stag gzig phag nag rgyal mtshan dang*// sha khrag snying dang bshos bu dang*// klu sman ga bur gser skyems dang*// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan dang*/ nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sprul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba kun// bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// stongs grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad zlog /phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong zlog /chags che lan chags 'dis bskang ngo*// dus la bab nas 'chir thug na'ang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud la// lo gsum bar du bshol bar mdzod// klu bdud kyi gyer/

hūm̐ skye dgu'i nyon mongs dug gsum gzugs// klu bdud nā ga rāk+ṣa ste// lto 'phye kun gyi mnga' bdag po// sbal mgo khrag mig de yi yum// lto 'phye zhe nag skye dgur gzan// 'jam dpal sprul pa der snang nas// klu la klu nyid gshed du phab// sku ni gdong gcig srin po'i bzhin// sbrul nag brgyad po gdengs kar che// 'jigs pa bcu drug phyag dang ldan// sku smad sbrul gyi gzugs su snang*// dga' bo 'jog po mtha' yas dang*// dung skyong nor rgyas pad+ma dang*// pad chen rigs ldan rgya mtsho dang*// klu yi rgyal po thams cad dang*// klu yi blon po gdug pa can// ba mgo can dang glang mjug can// sbrul mjug can dang sbrul mgo lnga// sbal mgo can dang nya mjug rigs// 'bu sgra 'don dang rta skad 'tsher// bram ze rje rigs dmangs rigs dang*// gdol pa la sogs klu yi 'bangs// 'jig rten khams na ci mchis pa// sa bdag lto 'phye sbrul gzugs dang*// lo zla zhag dang za ma dang*// spar sme la sogs sa bdag dang*// gnyan chen 'brug chen 'byin pa sogs// srid pa gsum gyi gnyan gyi rje// gnyan po ge sar skad chen sogs// gnyan gyi blon po thams cad dang*// kha yas kha yas bya dmar sogs// gnyan gyi phyag brnyan thams cad dang*// spang gnyan sa gnyan chu gnyan sogs// gnyan gyi g.yog 'khor thams cad de// lto 'phye'i mgon po chen po ni// rang rigs sde dpung bcas pa la// ngar gyi ri rab khra bo na// bang rim gsum pa bum pas brgyan// klu sman dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// sbrul mgo bdun lnga bzhi dang gsum// gnyis gcig chu rta chu glang dang*// chu lug chu mi bshos dang skyems// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sprul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba rnams// bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// stong grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad sgyur// phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong zlog

/chags che lan chags 'dis bskang ngo*// dus la bab nas 'chir thug na'ang*// sngon gyi las kyi 'phro 'thud la// lo gsum bar du bshol bar mdzod// btsan gyi gyer/ hūm̐ pha ni chu srin rgyal mtshan can// nag po bdud kyi sde dpon la// yul ni rdo rje gar dbang ma// de gnyis bshos pa'i lcam sring gnyis// ming po yab shud dmar po ste// gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg rtse can// sring mo nag mo re ma ti// khros pas gdong dmar ma zhes grags// sku la zangs kyi ya lad dang*// mdung dang zhags sogs sna tshogs 'dzin// de nyid brdzus shing sprul pa ni// dmu btsan rol pa glog 'gyu ma// de gnyis gshos las thog rje dkar// de dang klu btsan dmar po gshos// lha btsan la bzhi ming sring 'grub// sa yi rta po rgya gram la// mi lus rta mgo phyogs bzhir ba lta// shar bltas dung sgong chags pa brdol// mi dkar rta dkar a se rgyal// ya ba skya cig phyag brnyan can// lhor bltas g.yu sgong brdol ba las// mi sngon rta sngon ya btsan khra// nub bltas bse sgong dmar po brdol// mi dmar lta dmar skyes bzang sdom// byang bltas lcags sgong nag po brdol// mi nag rta nag chu rje sri// phyag brnyan dung ba gung btsan dang*// khu btsan chu yi phyag brnyan can// yang cig skyi yi mi bo che// grir gum 'khrungs nas mtshan gsol ba// skyes bu rlung btsan de yi sras// btsan gyi stong sde sum brgyar gyes// nyi ma shar ba'i zer las byung*// chu bo 'bab pa'i rtsal las byung*// zla ba shar ba'i mdangs las byung*// na bun 'thibs pa'i nang nas byung*// 'tshub mar 'khyil ba'i khrod nas byung*// shwa dang 'od pa'i sna las byung*// btsan gyi blon po chen po ni// chab bzang gling re skyes pa 'khrungs// bya btsan shu bo skyes su btags// de dang sman du gshos pa las// lha btsan spun drug de la skyes// byang rgyal bzhi dang blon po bzhi// byang gi phyug po bzhi dang ni// byang gi sgo ba bzhi la sogs// lha btsan drag po stong sde gcig

/klu btsan gtum po stong sde gcig /bdud btsan nag po stong sde gcig /gza' btsan khra bo stong sde gcig /srin btsan 'bar ba stong gcig /dmu btsan rol pa stong sde gcig /btsan 'gong g.yag po stong sde gcig /skar btsan yar ba stong sde gcig /grib btsan shu bo stong sde gcig /sman btsan bsil ma stong sde gcig /lab btsan yul po stong sde sogs// stong sde bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang*// rgya gar yul dang bod kyi gling*// rgya nag la sogs yul gyi btsan// stong sde sum brgya drug cu dang*// 'khor tshogs bdun brgya nyi shu ste// phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur zhing*// thod 'phreng rtsal gyi dam la btags// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bsrung mar bskos// btsan gyi mgon po chen po ni// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// rin chen zangs las grub pa'i mkhar// sngon po g.yu yi kha bad btang*// ru mtshon dmar po phyogs bzhir btsugs// nag po lcags ris kun nas bskor// zhabs ni dbang chen gzhi la bgrad// dpangs ni srid pa'i rtse dang mnyam// che ba'i yon tan bsam las 'das// rta ra khyi glang dmar po dang*// g.yag kham khra 'ug srin bya dang*// lug gi rgyal mtshan sha khrag snying*// dgyes pa'i bshos bu gser skyems dang*// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// nam mkha' shing bris rgyang bu dang*// mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong dang*// bal ti shug ti la sogs pa// dngos su 'byor zhing bkod pa dang*// yid kyis dmigs shing sprul pa rnams// rang gi rigs sde 'khor bcas kyi// mthu stobs byin rlabs mnga' ba rnams// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// stongs grogs mdzad phyir bzhes su gsol// pho brgyud byol kha dgra la gtod// mo brgyud dal kha dgra la khye// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad sgyur// phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong zlog

nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'dug /khyed kyi rkan phugs g.yon pa na// ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu 'dug /khyod kyi 'khyog po'i blta thabs la// glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'dug /gang bzang nor bzang yang dag shes/ ku be ra dang 'brog gnas dang*// lngas rtsen pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li// dzam+bha la ste nor bdag brgyad// nag po 'bar ba la sogs pa// drag po'i las sgrub lcags khrab can// gtum po nyi ma'i gzi brjid sogs// rgyas pa'i las 'grub gser khrab can// ha la 'bar byed la sogs pa// dbang gi las byed bse khrab can// 'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs pa// zhi ba'i las sgrub g.yu khrab can// so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam mi khyab// gnod sbyin mgon po chen po ni// rang rigs sde dang 'khor bcas la// ngar gyi ri rab bang rim gsum// rta g.yag ra lug khyi dang dom// spre'u bong bu bya dang mi// bud med dred dang dre'u phag /de dag rnams kyi rgyal mtshan dang*// sha khrag snying dang bshos bu dang*// 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud// 'khor bcas thugs la bzhed pa'i dkor// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa//
